topics.label: Course Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the cancer biology lecture series, outlines student backgrounds, and presents the session's key learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic Alterations and Disruption of Cellular Differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how accumulated genetic and epigenetic alterations cause normal cells to lose their differentiated state and disrupt tissue architecture.

topics.label: Tumor Invasion, Metastasis, and Malignancy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how invasive growth and metastatic spread distinguish malignant tumors from benign lesions both clinically and histologically.

topics.label: Stepwise Progression and Clinical Impact of Precursor Lesions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics use the colorectal model to illustrate the stepwise transition from benign precursor polyps to invasive carcinomas and examine the clinical risks of benign growths.

topics.label: Tumor Classification and Nomenclature
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the standard conventions and notable exceptions used in naming benign and malignant neoplasms across different tissue types.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Morbidity and Mortality in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the mechanical, physiological, and metastatic mechanisms through which tumors cause systemic illness and death.

topics.label: Cancer Incidence Across Human Tissues and Animal Species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the epidemiological distribution, prevalence, and mortality of cancer types across human populations and other animal species.

topics.label: Principles and Modalities of Cancer Screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the clinical rationale, histological indicators, and practical challenges of population-based cancer screening programs across different organ sites.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Practical Preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a reminder of the learning outcomes and a preview of the upcoming practical sessions.
